title: Professional Networking App
description: A LinkedIn-style platform focusing on specific niche industries. Users can create profiles, connect, and post updates.

modules.name: User Profiles & Resumes
modules.description: Detailed profiles highlighting work experience and skills.

modules.name: Connection Graph
modules.description: Using a graph database to manage connections and calculate 'degrees of separation'.

modules.name: Activity Feed
modules.description: Chronological and algorithmic feed of posts from connections.

modules.name: Messaging System
modules.description: Direct messaging between connected professionals.

title: Short-Form Video Platform
description: A TikTok clone focused on sharing 15-60 second educational clips. Includes video processing, filters, and an infinite scroll feed.

modules.name: Video Transcoding Pipeline
modules.description: Automatically converting uploaded videos into adaptive bitrates (HLS).

modules.name: Recommendation Algorithm
modules.description: Serving the infinite feed based on user watch time and engagement.

modules.name: Interactive Player
modules.description: Mobile UI for swiping between videos instantly with pre-loading.

modules.name: Audio Library Integration
modules.description: Allowing users to dub their videos with tracks from a predefined library.

project_objectives: Start video playback instantly upon swiping

title: Community Moderation Dashboard
description: An administrative tool for large online communities to moderate content, utilizing AI for automated toxicity detection.

modules.name: Automated Flagging
modules.description: Using NLP models to detect hate speech, spam, and toxicity in real-time.

modules.name: Moderator Queue
modules.description: Efficient UI for human moderators to review flagged content quickly.

modules.name: Appeals System
modules.description: Workflow for users to appeal bans and content removals.

modules.name: Analytics & Reporting
modules.description: Dashboards showing community health metrics and moderation response times.

project_objectives: Provide moderators with sub-second interface navigation

title: Audio Chat Rooms
description: A Clubhouse-style platform where users can host and join live audio panels and discussions.

modules.name: Room Management
modules.description: Creating scheduled or impromptu rooms with speaker/listener roles.

modules.name: Live Audio Streaming
modules.description: Low-latency audio broadcast to potentially thousands of listeners.

modules.name: Hand-Raising Mechanism
modules.description: System for listeners to request speaking privileges from moderators.

modules.name: Live Transcription
modules.description: Optional closed captioning generated in real-time for accessibility.

project_objectives: Support rooms with up to 5,000 concurrent listeners

title: Creator Monetization Platform
description: A Patreon-like system where creators can offer subscription tiers and exclusive content to their fans.

modules.name: Subscription Tiers
modules.description: Creators defining multiple pricing levels and associated perks.

modules.name: Gated Content Delivery
modules.description: Ensuring only active subscribers can view posts, videos, or files.

modules.name: Payout Management
modules.description: Handling monthly billing, tax withholding, and transferring funds to creators.

modules.name: Engagement Tools
modules.description: Polls, Q&As, and direct messaging exclusive to patrons.
